items.title: Antarctica's biggest land animal is a midge
items.summary: Antarctica's biggest land animal is smaller than a grain of rice. It is a wingless midge, Belgica antarctica, at most 6 millimeters long. Larvae winter at minus 2 to minus 10 Celsius, dry out by up to about 70 percent of their body water, then freeze solid and survive down to around minus 20. Idea from Cleo Abram's Antarctica Short. Photos: Igor Gvozdovskyy and Julien Renoult (CC BY 4.0). Footage: NASA.

items.title: How to make faceless reels with Claude Code, in five steps
items.summary: How to make faceless reels with Claude Code, in five steps. One. Open my reel skill in Claude Code. Two. Tell it the topic and the reel you want to copy. Three. Give it one source file, because every number on screen has to be in it. Four. Let it work. It writes the script, records the voiceover, builds every scene, adds the captions, and checks each number against the source before I see it. Five. I watch it once, then post it. Then I make the next one. Idea: @adilet.fndr #shorts #claudecode #reels

items.title: Priya applied to 312 jobs and got three interviews
items.summary: Priya applied to 312 jobs and got three interviews. Mass applying with AI doesn't work. The fix is smaller: find the 15 roles where you're the obvious choice. Write one sentence: the kind of company, the kind of role, and the one skill you're best at. Hers was Senior PM roles at Series B or C B2B SaaS companies, where she can use her enterprise workflow expertise. Then you only apply where that sentence is true. Lower volume, higher success rate. Source: my Unicorn Candidate-Market Fit newsletter, Oct 31 2025. #shorts #pmjobs
